Note that you must set the cbSize member to sizeof(CURSORINFO) before calling this function. ## -returns Type: BOOL If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero. To get extended error information, call GetLastError. ## -see-also CURSORINFO Conceptual Cursors GetGUIThreadInfo Reference
